data.one_liner: Dart web backend framework core with HTTP server, router, DTO validation, caching, OpenAPI and WebSocket support
data.what_it_does: Provides a native HTTP server, routing, typed DTO input validation, caching, OpenAPI docs, and WebSocket handling for building scalable Dart APIs.
use_when: Building a full‑stack Dart backend API
Need typed request validation and automatic 422 responses
Want built‑in caching and OpenAPI docs
Require WebSocket support on the same port
avoid_when: You only need a simple HTTP client
You prefer a minimal server like shelf
You are building a Flutter mobile app
strengths: Full feature set (router, DTO, cache, OpenAPI, WebSocket)
Typed DTO validation with code generation
Native Rust HTTP server for performance
weaknesses: Requires build_runner for DTO code generation
Heavier than minimal servers like shelf
data.setup_notes: Add dox_core to pubspec, run `dart run build_runner build` for DTO generation, configure AppConfig in main, optionally add dox_cache or dox_storage for caching.

alternatives.name: shelf
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight server for simple HTTP APIs without DTO validation or OpenAPI

alternatives.name: firebase_core
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need Firebase backend services instead of a custom server
